Defined in: experiments/star-field/starfield-engine.ts:106

Flies the camera to a body — catalog slugs resolve through the anchors map; registry ids (star-NNNNNN…) resolve through the shard index to their true heliocentric position. Called by the host for both nav picks and canvas raycast picks — onSelect is only fired by the pointer path (picking.ts) so selection never loops.

Catalog body id or registry id.

setHint()

setHint(id, rec?): void;

Defined in: experiments/star-field/starfield-engine.ts:171

Navigator-hover position hint — arms the hint record for the row under the pointer/focus so trackHover reports the body's projected (edge-clamped) screen position every tick: the hint locates the object at any zoom level, on- or off-screen. Catalog ids store their anchor (live world position); registry rows store their shard record so the static shard point resolves in the pinned frame. Also echoes onHover so the tooltip label + aria-live announce populate the same way canvas hover does. Pass null to clear.

Parameters

id

string | null

Hovered body id, or null to clear the hint.

rec?

SFRegistryRecord

Registry record when id is a shard id (star-NNNNNN…).

void

rotateView()

rotateView(dAzimuth, dPolar): void;

Defined in: experiments/star-field/starfield-engine.ts:200

Arrow-key orbit — rotates the camera around the controls target in screen-intuitive steps: left/right change azimuth, up/down change polar (clamped off the poles). Pure spherical math on the offset vector — no three types needed, and any running fly-to is cancelled so manual control wins.

Parameters

number

Azimuth delta in radians (left = -, right = +).

flyHome()

flyHome(): void;

Defined in: experiments/star-field/starfield-engine.ts:221

Overview — glides to the solar-system vantage: the camera tracks the Sun anchor's live position (it rides the rotating galactic disc, so a fixed target would strand the view on empty space) at the HOME standoff, which frames the tier out to the Kuiper belt. Falls back to the scene origin only while anchors are unavailable.
